Hi Lars — thanks for the callout, and sorry for the ambiguity. Good to know you're in CET. To avoid confusion, here are two clear options with conversions (all dates Tue, Mar 9):

Option A (morning PT / midday ET / evening CET):
- 9:00 AM PT (PDT, UTC-7)  / 12:00 PM ET (EDT, UTC-4)  / 5:00 PM CET (UTC+1)  / 9:30 PM IST (UTC+5:30)

Option B (later CET-friendly):
- 4:00 PM PT (PDT, UTC-7)  / 7:00 PM ET (EDT, UTC-4)  / 12:00 AM CET next day (not ideal)

Notes: US daylight savings starts on Sun Mar 8, 2026 — after that our Pacific office will be on PDT (UTC-7). Europe switches later in March, so CET will still be UTC+1 on Mar 9. I included UTC offsets above to avoid ambiguity.

We prefer Option A (9:00 AM PT / 5:00 PM CET) since it keeps the session within typical working hours for both teams. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite (Calendly link below for your records).

Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/demo-30m?month=mar-2026

Thanks — Jordan
